title: If a move fails partway, nobody is changed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop moves three customers to Net 45, but the move cannot complete.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-34 N15, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-34 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-34 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-34 Charlie.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 3 Customers" while the move cannot complete.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the dropdown shows Net 45.
  • Step 4: the app's error alert shows "Couldn't move the customers. Nothing was changed. Please try again." The window stays open and all three customers are still on {Term-A} with no note.

A manual tester cannot force a failure in the middle of a move; this is for an automated check or a developer-made failure.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If the move fails partway, no customer is changed (all or nothing) and the app's standard error alert shows "Couldn't move the customers. Nothing was changed. Please try again." The window stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move fails partway | "Couldn't move the customers. Nothing was changed. Please try again." | Standard error alert, window stays open”
